catalog_rules.scope: finite initial loot across Arroio, rural area, lake cabins and prison; new definitions/actions/assets not implemented by this catalog
catalog_rules.probability_note: Weights are relative within eligible candidates, not percentages or guarantees. Apply profile, room, site state, item condition, budget and physical fit before weighted selection without replacement.
catalog_rules.quantity_note: All generic item guarantees are zero. After selection use the item min/max. Packs/bottles are items with separate remaining contents, never infinite uses. Existing stack limits remain authoritative. Unit details pending definition cannot be used by a production generator.
generation_sequence: Assign permanent world/site/container IDs and explicit content version.
Preallocate rare quotas, narrative keys and visible props from sorted stable IDs, independent of exploration order; never lock a needed key behind its own lock.
Assign a correlated site state, then room and container profile; do not roll every room as an unrelated household.
Roll empty once, then draw count in range; select weighted eligible families without replacement.
Choose approved cosmetic variant after family selection; draw quantity and condition.
Apply container and shared site budget, region reservation and physical fit; exhausted budgets never create replacement items.
Commit concrete items, empty results, source and reserved prop claims atomically. Read saved result on all later access.

finite_policy.save_migration: Preserve UIDs, removed quantities, searched-empty containers and collected props. Legacy generic aliases are migrated explicitly; never create duplicate replacements.
finite_policy.nested_containers: Generate contents once using stable child IDs, finite depth and same budget; empty organizer definition does not include hidden loot.
finite_policy.visible_props: Count each existing pickup against site/region budgets before rolls and exclude its reserved instance from hidden selection.
finite_policy.initial_world_vs_production: Farming, fishing, water collection and crafting are separate future systems with inputs and ecology; no container respawn is implied.

condition_policies.durable_wear: Used/worn/broken context states; no automatic conversion of broken goods into usable equipment.
condition_policies.food_integrity_and_storage: Age, seal, packaging, humidity, infestation, contents and storage determine usability; canned or dry does not guarantee edible after three years.
condition_policies.abandoned_perishable_unusable: Initial abandoned fridge/freezer has no edible fresh goods. Fresh food only from a supported recent event or future production with provenance.
condition_policies.medical_expiry_and_seal: Track packaging, expiry, remaining doses and storage. Definition or label never guarantees safe/effective use. Game effects remain to implement.
condition_policies.seed_viability: Species, lot age, humidity and viable fraction; no guaranteed germination.
condition_policies.aged_fuel: Age, contamination, type, volume and compatible equipment; usable fuel exceptional.
condition_policies.battery_charge_and_health: Separate chemistry, format, charge, health and corrosion; abandoned cells are not implicitly charged.

budget_proposal.commercial_budget: Set after inventory of real accessible furniture and business size; not one identical cap for a school and a pharmacy.
budget_proposal.specialized_site_multiplier: Allocate specialized stock into the same regional limit, never add a second independent supply.
budget_proposal.binding_keys: Local authored placement with reachability validation; excluded from generic quotas.
budget_proposal.status: starting proposal, not calibrated or active; no minimum regional supply guarantee

exclusions: No decoration or fixed furniture as backpack loot by default.
No random identical inventory on every fixture.
No graves as searchable containers by default.
Firearms, ammunition, explosives, livestock and complete vehicles require their own future catalog and systems; this revision does not invent stock or combat rules.

instance_fields.notes: Store quantities with explicit units; zero charge is distinct from broken; empty is distinct from contaminated; no automatic repair or disassembly; every consumption or crafting transaction conserves inputs and outputs and is saved atomically.

acceptance: No fresh edible goods in old powerless refrigerators.
No duplicate reserved props or key IDs.
No refill on reload, version change or different search order.
Every realized placement fits and is accessible; no item generation from sealed wall volumes.
All approved HUD actions retain inventory conservation.
Icons/models and actual use actions are tracked separately from catalog existence.
